en: A vintage postcard depicting a public square with the German Fountain (La fontaine de l'Empereur Guillaume II) prominently in the center. The fountain is a domed, octagonal structure with columns. In the background, there are visible minarets and the large domed structure of the Hagia Sophia, indicating a significant historical and architectural area. People in historical attire are seen walking in the square. The postcard has a tinted colorization typical of early 20th-century postcards, and French text at the top.
